correctness.rationale: The single-pole integral is 2 Gamma(1-1/beta) s^(1/beta). Joint triangular-array Laplace functional splits into two marginals minus convolution overlap; convergence follows from g continuity, local coordinate scaling and integrable beta>1 tails (infinity separation gives zero overlap). Layer-cake intersections of moving centered intervals give strict decrease, differentiating convolution and integration by parts gives J0-Jdelta = beta*s*t*Gamma(2+1/beta)/(s+t)^(2+1/beta)*delta^2+o(delta^2), and splitting two neighborhoods gives C_beta*(t*s^(1/beta)+s*t^(1/beta))*delta^(-beta)+o. Scaling J_delta(cs,ct)=c^(1/beta)J_(delta*c^(-1/beta))(s,t) rules out joint positive stable homogeneity for delta in (0,infinity). Independent fresh quadrature beta=2,s=0.8,t=1.3 found small-delta coefficient ratio 0.99997165 at 0.01 and large-delta coefficient ratio 0.99974208 at delta=100; this corroborates but does not prove all-beta assertions.
